note: Package: geometry and viewport/arrange commands exist. UI: no Zenuxs-owned canvas or selection surface is wired; the visible editor remains OpenPencil-owned. Automation: src/app/zenuxs-engine.ts exposes a separate headless Session. Behavior tests: package engine and geometry tests.

Automation: the separate Zenuxs Session is exposed by src/app/zenuxs-engine.ts, and AI tools create Zenuxs rectangles, vectors, and text with solid fills. Behavior tests: color, pathops, and render package tests plus the Zenuxs AI tool and designer browser tests; they do not prove complete FigCraft parity.

Package: layout and text packages plus registered text commands exist; documented gaps include on-path text, preview, and font-database behavior. Behavior tests: engine, layout, and text package tests cover selected contracts only.

Automation: registered Zenuxs commands are reachable through the exposed Session. Behavior tests: document and engine package suites cover selected behavior; remaining command gaps are in the generated inventory.

Automation: direct format package APIs exist; no Zenuxs CLI workflow is evidenced. Behavior tests: package round-trip and app adapter tests.

Behavior tests: engine tests exercise sticky-note, template, and codegen commands; breadth remains partial.

The prior 570 occurrence total counted a macro documentation mention; 111/570 is stale. Behavior tests cover selected engine and MCP contracts only.
